subject: mathematics
concept: Evaluating whether a real-world data claim is well-supported by the evidence presented
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Truth Seeking Pillar — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student examines a realistic data claim (chart or scatter plot) and identifies whether the conclusion drawn is actually supported
exercise.abstract: Student explains whether a described data-based claim is well-supported, overstated, or missing key context

misconception_flags: accepts a claim as proven based on a weak correlation or a misleading graph presentation
